title: Oracle Evening Brief
script_summary:
Bitcoin sits primed for a surge as whale accumulation accelerates with the Fed's rate ceiling reached, freeing miners and large holders to front-run without interference. Price closed at sixty-four thousand after dipping 1.8 percent, with bids holding the sixty-two thousand zone. 

Hashrate at eight hundred eighty-one EH/s shows operators locked in. Dominance at fifty-six point four nine percent signals capital rotating into Bitcoin ahead of further moves off exchanges.
